column1: Autopilot Ahmedabad: Three-way match enterprise export
System of origin: SAP S/4HANA MM and FI (EKKO, EKPO, MSEG, RBKP, RSEG, MARA, MARM) with the group variance policy
Organisation: Ashvaka Industries Group (fictional). Currency INR. Timezone IST (UTC+05:30).

Sheets: EKKO_PO_Header, EKPO_PO_Item, MSEG_Goods_Receipt, RBKP_Invoice_Header, RSEG_Invoice_Item, RSEG_Prior_Invoiced, MARA_Material, MARM_UoM_Conversion, Approver_Matrix, Vendor_Master_Extract, Field_Dictionary
Folders: documents/invoices/ (PDF images of some of the parked invoices, as received from vendors); reference/ (the group's invoice variance policy)
Treat 09 Oct 2026, 18:00 IST as the current time, and keep the business date as a setting in your build.
Send outbound mail only to mailboxes you control. Every address in this pack is fictional.
Quantities in EKPO and RSEG_Prior_Invoiced are in the PO order unit. Receipt and invoice quantities are in the unit shown on the row.
The variance policy is in reference/Variance_Policy.md and .pdf.
Fully synthetic. No real company, person, account or identifier.
Import into your own systems of record, document store and mail channel, then work through them.
Google integrations are in beta for this event: do not use Google Drive, Sheets or Gmail for this data.
